comments.author: Port Official
comments.body:
i don't rememmber where i read this at, but here's what I learned about acquiring the legendary 5 second tech loads: You must keep techs activated for them to count for this. The more techs you have the faster they load. For every 5 battle techs you reduce one second, for every two merchant techs you reduce one second, for every two adventurer techs you reduce one second, to a minimum of five seconds.
This is why it is so desirable to get as many battle techs as you can in all different weapons. Say you are using a sword, but you have five techs for spear, bow, throwing knife, gun, and club, that's six seconds less time between tech loads and you don't have to worry about a bow tech popping up when you are using a sword.
